result.summary: Found several layout and content issues: truncated restaurant names, incomplete promo banner text, and inconsistent card image framing that make the home screen look broken.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' has its name truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, so the title is cut off mid-word at the card edge.
issues.suggestion: Constrain title width to the card, use text truncation with ellipsis (e.g. line-clamp), or allow wrapping so the full name is readable.

issues.description: Promo banner body copy is incomplete: 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' ends abruptly with no closing context or period, looking like cut-off text.
issues.suggestion: Complete the sentence (e.g. 'min. order €10') and ensure the full string fits within the banner without being clipped.

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow the right edge with a partially visible chip after 'Healthy', and the row has no clear fade or affordance that more filters exist beyond the edge.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle gradient fade on the trailing edge or ensure chips scroll with a clear peek of the next item; keep this as intentional carousel behavior if designed that way.

issues.description: Restaurant images in the 'Fastest near you' row have uneven padding and soft edges; the leftmost plate image sits in a much lighter, washed-out container compared to the darker burger and pasta cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize card image backgrounds, border-radius, and overlay contrast so all tiles in the carousel share the same visual treatment.

issues.description: Delivery fee on Green Bowl Poké shows '€0.90 delivery' while the popular ramen card emphasizes '€0 delivery', making the fee labeling inconsistent and slightly harder to scan.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent format for delivery cost (e.g. always '€X.XX delivery' or a badge) across list and featured cards.
